messages:
Jordan @AcmeAI: Hey team — invoice flagged: one request was billed ~380 tokens but our client-side SDK estimator reported ~120. This was a streaming flow where we stop after partial text. Repro steps below.

Jordan @AcmeAI: Repro (JS):
```js
const r = await client.chat.stream({
  model: 'redwood-2-large',
  messages: [ { role: 'system', content: 'You are a helpful assistant.' }, { role: 'user', content: 'Summarize my notes' } ],
  stop_on: '\n',
});
for await (const chunk of r) {
  if (chunk.text.includes('[DONE]')) break; // client stops early
}
```
Request id: req_0a1b2c

Maria (Support): Thanks — can you paste the raw response headers/req id and the invoice line? Also did you pass any function/tool hooks or special system content? :mag:

Jordan @AcmeAI: Invoice line id inv_99b7, request header x-req-id=req_0a1b2c, no explicit functions in our call. We do have a persistent system prompt and sometimes an in-house reranker (server-side) is enabled via routing.

Jamie (SDK): Which SDK version? Our estimator v0.9.4 uses the client tokenizer and doesn't account for server-injected tool responses or eventual assistant prefixes inserted after streaming reconnects.

Jordan @AcmeAI: SDK 0.9.4 indeed. We used streaming and then aborted when we got enough content (client-side). The meter shows full completion length.

Alex (Billing): Can engineering pull metering logs for req_0a1b2c and inv_99b7? If server-injected content was appended after the stream closed it would still be metered. @MeteringBot can you pull the metering TL for that req?

MeteringBot: metering-log req_0a1b2c: model=redwood-2-large, counted_tokens=382, breakdown: prompt=60 (incl system ops), completion=322 (includes function response injected by reranker id rerank-21), meter_ts=1715032125

Maria (Support): Ah — reranker appended a function response after client stopped streaming, that function output is counted in server metering. SDK estimator didn't see that output so it undercounted. :white_check_mark:

Jamie (SDK): Filing a patch to make estimator include a configurable safety buffer and to fetch server-side configured hooks (like rerankers) when available. Short-term: recommend clients set a buffer or call a final non-streaming confirm to get the full token count.

Jordan @AcmeAI: Got it — thanks everyone. If you can add a KB note we can adjust billing expectations and update our usage alerts. :pray:

Alex (Billing): Note added to inv_99b7; will credit obvious mis-bills if needed after logs are validated. We'll follow up with the exact credit amount.

Maria (Support): Closing here — root cause: server-side reranker/tool output counted by meter but not visible to client estimator when streaming was aborted. Workaround + SDK fix tracked in #sdk-issues.
